stem: How do Joey in the story “Good Enough” and the speaker in the poem “Simply Me” DIFFER in the way they learn to accept their imperfections?
instruction: Use “Good Enough” and “Simply Me” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Joey needs to have a positive interaction with someone else, while the speaker listens to her internal voice.

options.label: B
options.text: Joey relies on the reassurance of his teammates, while the speaker ignores criticism from others.

options.label: C
options.text: Joey relies on support from his mother, while the speaker learns from her surroundings.

options.label: D
options.text: Joey uses his imperfections to improve, while the speaker weighs herself against others.
